newsitem.title: BELGIUM: OLOs end up, 10-20 yr curve seen flattening.
newsitem.headline: OLOs end up, 10-20 yr curve seen flattening.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds ended firmer in line with Bunds on Wednesday with players expecting the market to consolidate ahead of German December jobs data and a Bundesbank council meeting on Thursday.
Dealers were mixed on the outlook for bond prices, but many expect the wave of profit taking which started at the beginning of the year will continue in the coming days and weeks.
The 10 year-20 year OLO yield spread continued its recent flattening, as buyers looked for 20-year paper and 10-year paper's rise was held in check by upcoming supply later in the month.
"I expect further flattening in the 10-20 year," one dealer said.

The March 2007 OLO closed with a yield of 6.10 percent, down from 6.14 on Tuesday, a virtually unchanged 18 bp over the German 10-year benchmark. The March 2015 OLO yield ended at 6.71 percent, 57 bp above the 10-year OLO.
The old benchmark May 2006 OLO will be offered at OLO exchange auctions on January 14 and 21. The monthly OLO auction is set for January 27.
